lede: Notre Dame carries the stronger underlying team rating — +7.7 against -1.2, a 8.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Notre Dame -23.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Notre Dame winning 94% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is run defense, where Notre Dame leads Michigan State by 58 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 74% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
